name: Fish-raft village
kicker: Fish-farm rafts at the river junction
summary: The fish-raft village is a boat hour among raft houses that are also freshwater farms, at the junction of the Hậu and the Châu Đốc river. Vietnam Tourism calls the community about 50 years old. The color project painted the cages in six blocks. Counts in the sources are 165, more than 160, and 161. This is not Cái Răng. A pier tariff was not opened, so the fare is check on arrival.
getThere: By boat from the town bank, or by road to Cồn Tiên bridge.
heroCaption: A fish-farm raft house on the Bassac, the Hậu, at Châu Đốc

notice.title: This is not the Can Tho market
notice.body: Cái Răng is a produce market in Can Tho. These are fish-farm rafts at Châu Đốc. A posted pier fare was not opened. Check on arrival, and do not use a price quoted only in a resident interview.

body: Go by boat among raft houses that raise fish. Vietnam Tourism calls it a community about 50 years old, raising catfish and snapper for sale. The province says the early-2024 project “Làng bè Sắc Màu” painted 165 fish-farm rafts in six color blocks. VnExpress says more than 160 cages, and also 161, over more than 1 km, painted red, yellow, orange, green, blue, and purple, with lights after dark. Both counts stay. The photographs are the raft houses and the boats. They are not a night frame of the colored lights.

VnExpress places the rafts on the Châu Đốc river at then thị trấn Đa Phước, beside the old city, next to Cồn Tiên bridge. The province says you can combine them with Châu Phong and Đa Phước. High water, August to November, is the window the Vietnamese place page names for the floating villages.
A fixed length beyond a boat hour was not printed. A last-boat clock was not printed. Check both on arrival.

figures.caption: Boats tied alongside the raft houses on the Châu Đốc river
figures.alt: A man standing on a fish-farm raft with wooden boats alongside at Chau Doc

gettingThere: Take a boat from the town bank, or the road to Cồn Tiên bridge. Minutes were not printed. The province does not print a minute count for combining the rafts with the Cham villages either.

legs.heading: From the Châu Đốc riverbank
legs.body: By boat. A posted fare and a minute count were not opened. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cồn Tiên bridge
legs.body: By road to the bridge VnExpress names beside the rafts. Minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No closing hour was published. Lights after dark are described. A last boat is check on arrival.
admissionNote: No pier tariff was opened. Check on arrival. Do not budget a fare that appeared only in an interview.
